name: Dakshina Kalika Dhyanam
text:
AUM Karala Vadanam Ghoram, Mukta Keshaam Chaturbhujam
Khargam Mundam Cha Varam Cha, Abhayam Cha Dadhatim Kareem
Mahakal Samaaseenam, Smita Mukti Ruvaam Mukheem
Peet Asrig Digdha Sarvaangeem, Divyabharan Bhushitaam
Dakshinaam Dakshina Rupam, Bhaktanugrah Kaarineem
Sarva Vighna Haram Devim, Kaleem Vande Shivapriyam
meaning: A dhyana of Dakshina Kali, six lines to hold in the mind in meditation: her terrible face and loosened hair, her four hands, her seat with Mahakala, her body smeared with blood, her gracious Dakshina form, and her power to remove every obstacle.
purpose: A dhyana: a description to hold in the mind while meditating, not a single short mantra.
note: This is the version of Sarvakali’s guru, from her own notes, kept in its own order and wording. The meanings say what the words say, approved by Sarvakali.
source: Sarvakali’s teaching (her guru’s version); not a published text

parts.line: AUM Karala Vadanam Ghoram, Mukta Keshaam Chaturbhujam
parts.meaning: AUM. Her face gaping and terrible, fierce; her hair loosened; four-armed.

parts.line: Khargam Mundam Cha Varam Cha, Abhayam Cha Dadhatim Kareem
parts.meaning: In her hands she holds a sword and a severed head, and shows the gestures of blessing and of fearlessness.

parts.line: Mahakal Samaaseenam, Smita Mukti Ruvaam Mukheem
parts.meaning: Seated with Mahakala (Shiva as Time); her face smiling, granting liberation.

parts.line: Peet Asrig Digdha Sarvaangeem, Divyabharan Bhushitaam
parts.meaning: Her whole body smeared with the blood she has drunk; adorned with divine ornaments.
Dakshina, of the gracious southern form, who gives grace to her devotees.

parts.line: Sarva Vighna Haram Devim, Kaleem Vande Shivapriyam
parts.meaning: The Goddess who removes every obstacle: I bow to Kali, beloved of Shiva.

pronunciation: AUM ka-raa-la va-da-nam gho-ram, muk-ta kay-shaam cha-tur-bhu-jam; khad-gam mun-dam cha va-ram cha, a-bha-yam cha da-dha-teem ka-reem; ma-haa-kaal sa-maa-see-nam, smi-ta muk-ti ru-vaam mu-kheem; peet a-srig dig-dha sar-vaan-geem, div-yaa-bha-ran bhoo-shi-taam; dak-shi-naam dak-shi-na roo-pam, bhak-taa-nu-grah kaa-ri-neem; sar-va vigh-na ha-ram day-veem, kaa-leem van-day shi-va-pri-yam
